name: Cold Read
job: Give a reader with zero context the whole page in one glance: who, what, where, when and why as labelled slots, how as before, during and after with real timing, and one line on how to read the rest.

anatomy.role: Kit 27 section label (mono caps, label size), one per slot, in a fixed column on wide screens
Body size, full ink; hairline between slots
Three cells in order, before, during, after: label, timing line (small, semibold), one sentence; a short connector between cells

anatomy.token: Kit 31 callout in a neutral variant: `surface-2` and `border`; gold stays for limits and gaps

states.name: Full
states.note: Five slots, the three steps and the how-to-read line.

states.name: Slots only
states.note: When the timing is not known yet, leave the steps out rather than invent dates.

states.name: Short
states.note: Fewer slots for a smaller page; the order stays.

use_when: A page a reader may open cold: a proposal, a brief, a leave-behind (rule 13a).
The timing has real dates or a real trigger to state.
avoid_when: An internal page whose readers already have the context.
There is no real why-now; say so in the When slot instead of inventing urgency.

data.note: In the order of rule 13a: Why, What, then Who and Where if needed, then When, which states the real trigger (why now) or says there is none.
Before, during, after, each with a real date or time, or "not booked yet"; never a vague relative.
One line on how to read the page.

access: Slots are a `<dl>`: each label is a `<dt>`, each answer its `<dd>`, read in order.
The steps are an ordered list with an accessible name, so the sequence survives without the visual connector.
Static and always open: a cold-read header is never folded, so nothing it says is hidden; nothing is interactive; prints whole.
gates: `scripts/kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
`scripts/page_gate.py`, `scripts/token_source_gate.py`, and the Impeccable detector at 0 findings.
